task.subject: A work-item execution workflow in githubnext/gh-aw-cao that delegates repository work to agents
task.intent: Determine whether delegated agent assignments are staying fresh enough to move work items forward, surfacing stale or long-running assignments that need operator intervention and tracking attainment of timely assignment progress.
activationConditions: A repository operator enables a workflow in githubnext/gh-aw-cao that creates delegated agent assignments for work items.
At least one work item and its related agent assignment are observed within the dashboard horizon for that workflow.
An assignment remains active long enough to be classified as long-running or stale by canonical assignment evidence.
requiredEffects: Each hypothetical run must bind to a stable delegated work-item opportunity identified by work-item-id and assignment-id for the selected workflow.
The workflow must either advance the assignment or leave evidence showing why an operator must intervene on stale or blocked work.
Accepted repository evidence is limited to canonical work-item and agent-assignment records, their run and repository links, and the native operational-grader result for the same workflow scope.
noopConditions: No delegated work item exists for the selected workflow in the horizon.
All observed assignments are completed or otherwise not active, leaving no active queue to review.
Assignment evidence is unavailable or incomplete, so the dashboard cannot distinguish fresh work from stale work.
successConditions: The workflow activates on delegated work-item opportunities for the selected workflow.
Operators can identify active assignments, stale exceptions, and the affected work-item objective from canonical evidence alone.
The direct attainment metric remains the native ordered primary gh-aw operational-grader metric for timely assignment progress.
uncertainties: A non-stale assignment is not proof that the work item will complete successfully.
Long-running assignments may be expected for some objectives and still require operator review.
Missing operational-grader evidence must remain distinct from a zero attainment value.

operationalValue.opportunityBinding: One hypothetical run corresponds to one stable delegated work-item opportunity for the selected workflow, identified by work-item-id with its observed assignment-id evidence.
acceptedEvidence: work-items rows for the selected workflow and repository
agent-assignments rows for the same work-item-id
repository-link, run-link, and evidence-link fields attached to those rows when present
operational-graders rows for the same workflow scope
maturationRules: Use the direct metric only from canonical gh-aw operational-grader observations for the selected workflow.
Treat an opportunity as matured only when the operational-grader observation for that run is present and its primary metric is a finite number in [0,1].
zeroRules: A direct metric value of 0 means the canonical primary operational-grader metric reported zero attainment for the run.
Do not infer zero from stale assignment counts, incomplete evidence, or null metrics.
missingEvidenceRules: When no operational-grader observation exists for the selected workflow scope, attainment is missing rather than zero.
When assignment evidence is unavailable, incomplete, or absent, show execution evidence only and do not fabricate attainment.
operationalValue.preservation: Preserve metric IDs, order, native finite values or null, units, and directions exactly as published by gh-aw.
